nodes.label: Implement Exactly the API Contract
nodes.rationale: DTOs mirror backend JSON exactly; if the contract is ambiguous, stop and report back instead of guessing.

nodes.label: Use Case Class with single call()
nodes.rationale: Business rules (sorting, filtering) live in use cases, never in widgets.
nodes.norm_label: use case class with single call()

nodes.label: DTO fromJson + toEntity
nodes.rationale: JSON never leaks past data/; fields cast explicitly in fromJson.

nodes.label: Riverpod Providers as Sole Composition Root
nodes.rationale: Constructor injection everywhere, no global singletons; enables ProviderScope overrides in tests.
nodes.norm_label: riverpod providers as sole composition root

nodes.label: No Codegen (freezed, riverpod_generator)
nodes.rationale: Keep code plain Dart unless the CTO approves codegen.

nodes.label: Centralized Theme (core/theme/)
nodes.rationale: Colors, typography, spacing in one place; widgets never hardcode colors.

nodes.label: Dependency Rule (presentation -> domain <- data)
nodes.rationale: Domain layer is pure Dart and imports nothing from Flutter, http, Riverpod, or data/presentation.

nodes.label: Failure (error type)
nodes.rationale: Repositories convert every exception to Failure so the UI only shows Failure.message.

nodes.label: Layered Testing Strategy (mocktail, MockClient, ProviderScope overrides)
nodes.norm_label: layered testing strategy (mocktail, mockclient, providerscope overrides)

nodes.label: Car-Context UI Rules
nodes.rationale: Driving context demands glanceable UI: touch targets >=48dp (prefer 64dp+), high contrast, dark mode default, minimal text, short flows.
